options.text: Age kids should stop spitting up? Peak at about 4 months, stops by about 12
Recommended fluid for well child with hydration issues? 0.9% NaCL and 5% glucose + 20mmol KCL. Adjust if K or gluc is high, etc.

T/F Osgood Schlatter is almost never seen in adults? T, peaks between 10-15, is an often bilateral inflammation of the insertion of the patellar tendon into the tibial tubercle. Radiographs are rarely indicated, management is conservative with slow return to activity (i.e. RICE)
RF’s for SIDS? Smoking! Over wrapping the baby, sleep on stomach, soft bedding
Be on the lookout for infections several weeks ago (i.e. glomerulonephritis)
Red cell casts indicate? Bleeding is glomerular – glomerulonephritis, GAS beta hemolytic is most common in kids, can be asymptomatic or have general signs (malaise, fatigue, etc.)
